blocks.text: SEOUL — A woman was sentenced to three years and six months in prison for abandoning her ailing father, who died of malnutrition, the Incheon District Court said Tuesday. The court found the 39-year-old guilty of abandonment resulting in the death of a lineal ascendant. Her father was 76. From June until his death on July 22, 2025, she failed to provide him with food or medical care, despite his physical weakness and need for treatment.
